title: NL: Cost of Living
description: Dutch consumer prices broken down into all 12 COICOP spending categories (CBS), since 2025.

panels.title: CPI by spending category (2015=100)
panels.description: All 12 top-level COICOP categories CBS splits the CPI into.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT period_date AS time, CASE indicator WHEN 'cpi_cat_food_and_drink' THEN 'Food & non-alc. drink' WHEN 'cpi_cat_alcohol_and_tobacco' THEN 'Alcohol & tobacco' WHEN 'cpi_cat_clothing_and_footwear' THEN 'Clothing & footwear' WHEN 'cpi_cat_housing_water_energy' THEN 'Housing, water & energy' WHEN 'cpi_cat_furnishings_household' THEN 'Furnishings & household' WHEN 'cpi_cat_health' THEN 'Health' WHEN 'cpi_cat_transport' THEN 'Transport' WHEN 'cpi_cat_communication' THEN 'Communication' WHEN 'cpi_cat_recreation_and_culture' THEN 'Recreation & culture' WHEN 'cpi_cat_education' THEN 'Education' WHEN 'cpi_cat_restaurants_and_hotels' THEN 'Restaurants & hotels' WHEN 'cpi_cat_misc_goods_and_services' THEN 'Misc. goods & services' ELSE indicator END AS metric, value
FROM price_index
WHERE country_iso3='NLD' AND source='cbs' AND indicator IN ('cpi_cat_food_and_drink','cpi_cat_alcohol_and_tobacco','cpi_cat_clothing_and_footwear','cpi_cat_housing_water_energy','cpi_cat_furnishings_household','cpi_cat_health','cpi_cat_transport','cpi_cat_communication','cpi_cat_recreation_and_culture','cpi_cat_education','cpi_cat_restaurants_and_hotels','cpi_cat_misc_goods_and_services')
  AND period_date >= '2025-01-01' AND $__timeFilter(period_date)
ORDER BY 1

WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT indicator,
    (array_agg(value ORDER BY period_date ASC))[1] AS first_value,
    (array_agg(value ORDER BY period_date DESC))[1] AS last_value
  FROM price_index
  WHERE country_iso3='NLD' AND source='cbs' AND indicator IN ('cpi_cat_food_and_drink','cpi_cat_alcohol_and_tobacco','cpi_cat_clothing_and_footwear','cpi_cat_housing_water_energy','cpi_cat_furnishings_household','cpi_cat_health','cpi_cat_transport','cpi_cat_communication','cpi_cat_recreation_and_culture','cpi_cat_education','cpi_cat_restaurants_and_hotels','cpi_cat_misc_goods_and_services')
    AND period_date >= '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY indicator
)
SELECT CASE indicator WHEN 'cpi_cat_food_and_drink' THEN 'Food & non-alc. drink' WHEN 'cpi_cat_alcohol_and_tobacco' THEN 'Alcohol & tobacco' WHEN 'cpi_cat_clothing_and_footwear' THEN 'Clothing & footwear' WHEN 'cpi_cat_housing_water_energy' THEN 'Housing, water & energy' WHEN 'cpi_cat_furnishings_household' THEN 'Furnishings & household' WHEN 'cpi_cat_health' THEN 'Health' WHEN 'cpi_cat_transport' THEN 'Transport' WHEN 'cpi_cat_communication' THEN 'Communication' WHEN 'cpi_cat_recreation_and_culture' THEN 'Recreation & culture' WHEN 'cpi_cat_education' THEN 'Education' WHEN 'cpi_cat_restaurants_and_hotels' THEN 'Restaurants & hotels' WHEN 'cpi_cat_misc_goods_and_services' THEN 'Misc. goods & services' ELSE indicator END AS "Category",
       round((100 * (last_value / NULLIF(first_value, 0) - 1))::numeric, 2) AS "Change since Jan 2025, %"
FROM bounds
ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT DISTINCT ON (indicator) CASE indicator WHEN 'cpi_cat_food_and_drink' THEN 'Food & non-alc. drink' WHEN 'cpi_cat_alcohol_and_tobacco' THEN 'Alcohol & tobacco' WHEN 'cpi_cat_clothing_and_footwear' THEN 'Clothing & footwear' WHEN 'cpi_cat_housing_water_energy' THEN 'Housing, water & energy' WHEN 'cpi_cat_furnishings_household' THEN 'Furnishings & household' WHEN 'cpi_cat_health' THEN 'Health' WHEN 'cpi_cat_transport' THEN 'Transport' WHEN 'cpi_cat_communication' THEN 'Communication' WHEN 'cpi_cat_recreation_and_culture' THEN 'Recreation & culture' WHEN 'cpi_cat_education' THEN 'Education' WHEN 'cpi_cat_restaurants_and_hotels' THEN 'Restaurants & hotels' WHEN 'cpi_cat_misc_goods_and_services' THEN 'Misc. goods & services' ELSE indicator END AS "Category",
       value AS "Index (2015=100)", period_date AS "Month"
FROM price_index
WHERE country_iso3='NLD' AND source='cbs' AND indicator IN ('cpi_cat_food_and_drink','cpi_cat_alcohol_and_tobacco','cpi_cat_clothing_and_footwear','cpi_cat_housing_water_energy','cpi_cat_furnishings_household','cpi_cat_health','cpi_cat_transport','cpi_cat_communication','cpi_cat_recreation_and_culture','cpi_cat_education','cpi_cat_restaurants_and_hotels','cpi_cat_misc_goods_and_services')
ORDER BY indicator, period_date DESC
